problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 delivery routes through 10 different distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the shipment must be processed and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the hubs must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (H4, 10) → (H6, 9) → (H3, 3) → (H1, 4) → (H8, 1) → (H10, 8) → (H7, 2) → (H9, 4) → (H2, 8) → (H5, 5)
* R2 requires the sequence: (H10, 10) → (H5, 1) → (H9, 8) → (H1, 1) → (H6, 3) → (H8, 2) → (H3, 1) → (H2, 5) → (H7, 5) → (H4, 2)
* R3 requires the sequence: (H2, 10) → (H10, 10) → (H4, 8) → (H7, 1) → (H5, 9) → (H6, 10) → (H1, 8) → (H3, 7) → (H9, 5) → (H8, 10)
* R4 requires the sequence: (H1, 1) → (H4, 5) → (H6, 10) → (H3, 9) → (H7, 4) → (H2, 5) → (H9, 3) → (H10, 10) → (H5, 1) → (H8, 7)
* R5 requires the sequence: (H5, 10) → (H4, 6) → (H1, 5) → (H8, 7) → (H10, 9) → (H2, 2) → (H9, 9) → (H3, 8) → (H7, 4) → (H6, 5)
* R6 requires the sequence: (H5, 9) → (H1, 5) → (H6, 5) → (H10, 7) → (H3, 8) → (H7, 2) → (H8, 2) → (H9, 7) → (H2, 4) → (H4, 3)
* R7 requires the sequence: (H4, 9) → (H5, 8) → (H6, 6) → (H8, 2) → (H9, 4) → (H10, 10) → (H7, 8) → (H3, 5) → (H2, 10) → (H1, 2)
* R8 requires the sequence: (H1, 2) → (H10, 8) → (H2, 5) → (H6, 8) → (H7, 8) → (H8, 1) → (H4, 5) → (H3, 9) → (H5, 9) → (H9, 8)
* R9 requires the sequence: (H6, 10) → (H8, 4) → (H3, 1) → (H10, 5) → (H5, 2) → (H2, 7) → (H1, 6) → (H7, 7) → (H4, 6) → (H9, 3)
* R10 requires the sequence: (H10, 8) → (H7, 2) → (H8, 6) → (H2, 5) → (H4, 10) → (H9, 3) → (H5, 5) → (H1, 1) → (H6, 4) → (H3, 9)

Each hub stop must be completed without interruption once it begins,
and each distribution hub can only handle one shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all hub stops across the distribution network
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
